text: Late or incomplete upstream demand feed :: The upstream demand data source delivered current-window demand records late or only partially, causing the forecast-pipeline completeness check to fail repeatedly until the data caught up. :: Most likely a transient upstream demand data delay or gap, which cleared by 00:25:46Z.

Forecast pipeline ingestion lag :: Demand ingestion inside service:gridcast:forecast-pipeline fell behind its completeness-check deadline due to slow processing or a backlog, repeatedly emitting completeness.demand warnings. :: The pipeline temporarily could not keep up with demand data, then recovered.

Misconfigured completeness rule in forecast pipeline :: A recent configuration or logic change in the service:gridcast:forecast-pipeline demand completeness check caused it to compare against an incorrect expected demand window or volume. :: False-positive completeness warnings were generated by a rule mismatch inside the service.

Upstream demand schema or format change :: The upstream demand feed changed schema, units, or field formatting, causing demand records to be parsed as incomplete or invalid by service:gridcast:forecast-pipeline. :: An upstream change caused demand records to fail completeness validation until compatibility was restored.

Transient network or storage fault between demand source and pipeline :: Intermittent network timeouts or object-store read failures between the demand source and service:gridcast:forecast-pipeline caused partial demand reads, repeatedly triggering completeness warnings. :: A short infrastructure blip in the demand-data path caused the warning burst.
